transcript: Speaker A: Subah uthke sabse pehle kya karta hai? Instagram kholta hai. Trial is just 1 rupee.] Speaker B: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click install and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: FORMAL GRADUATION CEREMONY / CONVOCATION 2024, english, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer... [Disclaimer text regarding non-affiliation and results varying.]
